title: Refactor branching and validate through bounded Gradle output

rubric.text: The nested branch-local predicate is expressed as ordered guarded and unguarded Message branches without casts

Uses one managed wrapper workflow to run the fixture's supported test task with a non-empty question, reports its compact result, and successfully finishes the same workflow. The supplied gradlew simulation is the intended evidence for this workflow. The separate gradlew-real validator determines actual build success. A successful real build with test NO-SOURCE satisfies the validator for this fixture.
